name: The Concourse Project
desc: Indoor-outdoor warehouse club near the airport: main hall (18,000+ sq ft), mezzanine, two patios and a field. Austin's flagship electronic venue; DJ Mag Top 100 Clubs. Home of Seismic Dance Event.

name: Kingdom Nightclub
desc: Austin's long-running electronic club, reopened in the Red River Cultural District in 2022 with roughly double the original capacity and a heavy lighting rig.

name: Vulcan Gas Company
desc: Two-floor live music and club venue on 6th Street with two large bars and an outdoor terrace.

name: Coconut Club
desc: Multi-level downtown dance club with a rooftop and four indoor floors; DJ-led late nights and drag programming.

name: Stubb's
desc: Waller Creek outdoor amphitheater (about 2,100) plus an indoor music room. Austin's best-known mid-size outdoor stage.

name: Mohawk
desc: Multi-level indoor and outdoor venue: about 300 indoors, about 1,000 total with the tiered outdoor stage and patio. Also books private events.

name: Emo's
desc: About 1,700-capacity concert hall on East Riverside.

name: Historic Scoot Inn
desc: One of the oldest bars in Central Texas, with an outdoor concert lawn of about 800.

name: ACL Live at the Moody Theater
desc: Home of Austin City Limits tapings; up to 2,750.

name: Antone's
desc: Legendary blues club (founded 1975), about 400 capacity.

name: Brazos Hall
desc: Restored turn-of-the-century grain-mill warehouse at 4th & Brazos: main ballroom plus courtyard. Up to about 900–1,000.

name: Fair Market
desc: Iconic quonset-hut warehouse (12,000 sq ft) plus a 10,000 sq ft lawn. 1,000 standing inside, about 1,400 for the full property. Hosted SXSW immersive activations and the F1 Red Bull fan zone.

name: Distribution Hall
desc: Industrial-modern East Austin event complex with green room, production suites and a 7,000 sq ft courtyard. Full buyouts available.

name: Palm Door on Sixth
desc: Indoor and outdoor event venue on 6th Street, up to 1,000.

name: Palm Door on Sabine
desc: Intimate indoor and outdoor event space, up to 350.

name: North Door
desc: Indoor event venue, up to 300.

name: Trinity Hall
desc: Downtown indoor venue, up to 600, about 11,800 sq ft.

name: Mercury Hall
desc: Indoor and outdoor South Austin hall, up to 250.

name: Waller Ballroom
desc: Intimate ballroom on East 6th, up to 175.

name: Vuka
desc: Indoor and outdoor community event space, up to 200.

name: Long Center
desc: Performing arts center with an outdoor terrace overlooking the skyline, up to about 2,440.

name: Palm Park
desc: 1.56-acre downtown park for outdoor events, up to about 4,500.

name: Carson Creek Ranch
desc: 9.4-acre riverside ranch for festivals and large outdoor events, up to about 27,000.

name: NOWHERE
desc: Immersive cultural venue and conscious creative center in South Austin's St. Elmo Arts District. 12,000 sq ft of rooms: main event hall, salons, lounges, market stage and wellness room.
